reportText:
**17,125 of 39,148 matchup contexts reviewed (43.7%).**

- 10,767 single-seed confirmations; 6,358 multi-seed validations.
- 3,301 outcomes changed; 13,824 retained forecasts.
- 22,023 remain, including 24 held contexts and 8 diagnosed exhausted contexts.

Four workers are active. No completed-seed replays. Research checkpoints and this report are pushed; production is unchanged.

Next report: **18,000 reviewed**.
limitation: The ordered queue and agreement-dependent stopping cannot estimate unbiased global forecast accuracy. Single-seed confirmations remain distinct from multi-seed validations.
